description: Lists an app's files as being edited (its files with the unpublished draft over them): path, mimeType, size, sha, timestamps, `draft: true` if changed in the draft, and `where`: "pages" (code, counts in the file cap) or "assets" (binaries, count in MB). `missing` lists files whose content was lost: upload them again. Changes nothing.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_list_files
title: List an app's files
